 Yasin Latif Shaikh

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
....Applicant
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra And Another
 .....

Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Rahul R. Karpe
App for Respondents: Mr. R.K. Ingole.
 Coram : Mehroz K. Pathan, J.
 Date : 4th February, 2026.
P.C. :-
1. Notice returnable on 25th February, 2026.
2.
The learned App waives notice for State.

3.  The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is castigated with the responsibility of misappropriation of Rs.
21 Lakhs and odd amount over the period since he had been the Secretary of the Vividh Karyakari Seva Sahakari Sanstha, Rajapur.
The amounts shown to be recoverable and due at the instance of the present applicant were already paid by the applicant on 20.1.2026.

Receipts to that effect issued by the said Vividh Karyakari Seva Sahakari Sanstha,
Rajapur are annexed to the application.
Hence, the applicant may be protected.
4. Thus, taking into consideration the above submissions, I am inclined to protect the applicant till the investigation papers are seen.

Hence, the following order :-
 {2}
 ABA 163.26.odt  ORDER [I] In the event of arrest of the applicant, in connection with Crime No. 431 of 2025 registered with Belwandi Police Station, District Ahilyanagar for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 409,
420, 468 of the IPC the applicant Yasin Latif Shaikh be released on bail on furnishing PR Bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/-, with one or more sureties in the like amount, on the following conditions :-
Yasin Latif Shaikh vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91210705/
1

[i] The applicant shall attend the concerned police station and report to the Investigating Officer on 9 th, 10th, 16th, 17th and 20th and 21st February, 2026 between 11.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m. and shall cooperate with the investigation.
[ii] The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence.
[iii] The Investigating Officer shall make investigation papers available on next date of hearing.
[iv] The applicant shall submit his Aadhar and Pan card to the Investigating Officer alongwith mobile numbers and addresses of two of his near relatives and his current address.
